summary: The transfer finding had the same gap the verification finding had until last turn: its rationale leans on the call being offered as a way to hand leadership to a named server in the cluster, and the declared range started at the function rather than including the documentation above it. That promise is what makes a vote-less target a defect rather than an operator mistake, since the caller names a server the cluster contains and is told the transfer did not fail, so this adds the documentation range as a source and records the documented purpose as a behaviour, including the documentation's own warning that the call is safe in a cluster where not every node runs the latest version because an unpromotable follower fails gracefully - which is the shape of the case the finding exercises. Nothing else changed, no claim was added, and no execution was spent. That is the last thing that fits, and the record closes as follows. The captured tree is byte-identical to the released upstream copy of the same revision, so nothing here is injected. The most severe result is the durable term regression: an empty heartbeat taken by the transport's fast path off the main thread writes a term that the candidate's own read-modify-write then overwrites with a lower value, witnessed twice, causally separated from its instrumentation by a control, bounded by two uninstrumented probes at zero falls in 792 and 768 deliveries, with the remaining uncertainty stated as application order at the shared store key rather than latency and the discriminating test named for a successor. Around it stand the witnessed transfer to a vote-less member reported as success while moving authority nowhere, the AddVoter documentation promising a staging phase the implementation never enters with a case and a control, the accepted apply or barrier duty with no completion path after shutdown, and the configuration index handed back as a constant zero that disables the documented compare-and-swap. The source-decided findings are the heartbeat fast path bypassing the protocol gate and the leader verification counting sources outside its voter quorum, which an audit shows to be the only such count in the package, and both now carry their documented promises alongside their code. The negatives and corrections keep the record honest: the log cache, the commit index arithmetic, the bootstrap term write and the heartbeat release path each resolved against the suspicion, with the boundary of each negative stated.
